about_the_game:
The Puffs Pack unlocks the quirkiest characters yet, featuring the Gold & Blue Puffers, Ducky, and Sarge skins. It’s big, it’s fun, and it’s sure to make waves in the arena.

Hunt the depths in high-flying torpedo combat while showing off your playful, inflatable skins. As always, Tidal Shock is free to play, and your skins help define your unique style in this action-packed underwater world!

Support the Little Guys: Your purchase helps keep our indie studio afloat, and we appreciate every bit of support from our amazing community!
